items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.8 Flash as its most intelligent workhorse model, with claimed gains over 3.7 Flash on long-horizon software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning, at the same introductory price of $0.75/$3.75 per million input/output tokens through Dec. 31, 2026. A sibling model, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, is limited to trusted defenders via a new Fairwind Program for vulnerability discovery and automated patching. 3.8 Flash is rolling out in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode for Pro/Ultra, plus Gemini API, Antigravity, Android Studio, Sheets, and Gemini Enterprise.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash，稱其為目前最聰明的工作馬模型，相對 3.7 Flash 在長程軟體工程、代理任務與多步推理上有顯著提升，並維持至 2026 年 12 月 31 日的導入價每百萬 token $0.75／$3.75。同級的 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber 僅透過新設 Fairwind Program 提供給可信防禦方，用於漏洞發現與自動修補。3.8 Flash 已在 Gemini App、Search AI Mode（Pro／Ultra）、Gemini API、Antigravity、Android Studio、Sheets 與 Gemini Enterprise 上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: The third Flash drop in six weeks shows Google competing on cadence and cost, not only flagship size; independent scores put 3.8 Flash near other mid-frontier models, but extra diligence can raise token use. Cyber remains gated, so the defensive advantage is real only for approved partners, not the public API.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 六週內第三次 Flash 發布，顯示 Google 在節奏與成本上競爭，而不只拼旗艦規模；獨立評測顯示 3.8 Flash 接近其他中高階模型，但「更勤奮」可能推高 token 用量。Cyber 仍採准入制，防禦優勢目前只屬於獲准夥伴，而非公開 API。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re introducing Gemini 3.8, our best reasoning & coding model yet, at the same speed and low cost of 3.7.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天推出 Gemini 3.8，這是我們迄今最佳的推理與程式模型，速度與低成本與 3.7 相同。

items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 將於 10 天內推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Grok 4.7 “comes out in 10 days,” implying a target around September 12, after a user praised Grok 4.6. He did not publish a lab blog, system card, or benchmarks with the post. Earlier Musk comments had described 4.7 as a larger follow-on to 4.6 with supplemental SpaceX company data; those details were not restated in the new post.
items_flat.summary_zh: 馬斯克發文稱 Grok 4.7「10 天後推出」，推算目標約 9 月 12 日，是在有人稱讚 Grok 4.6 之後的回覆。貼文未附實驗室部落格、系統卡或基準數據。他先前曾形容 4.7 是比 4.6 更大的後續版本，並加入 SpaceX 公司資料做補充訓練；此次貼文未重述這些細節。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a dated teaser, not a release. Whether 4.7 actually lands on that day, and how it compares with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Fable 5.1, remains unverified until official evals ship.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是帶日期的預告，不是正式發布。能否如期上線、以及相對 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Fable 5.1 的實際差距，仍須等到官方評測才能確認。
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 將在 10 天後推出

brief_en: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash and restricted 3.8 Flash Cyber, keeping Flash pricing while targeting agents and defensive patching. Elon Musk said Grok 4.7 arrives in about 10 days. Other labs were quiet in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與限量 3.8 Flash Cyber，維持 Flash 價位並主打代理與防禦修補。馬斯克稱 Grok 4.7 約 10 天後上線。其餘大廠近 12 小時無重大新公告。
